einzeiler: The Pentagon secretly employs prominent right-wing social media influencers.
kurzfassung: Investigations revealed that the Pentagon quietly hired several high-profile conservative social media commentators as special government employees. The program came to light after one of these influencers panicked over ordinary administrative document markings and publicly accused a State Department official of entrapment. Following this exposure, journalists uncovered multiple other right-wing posters on the Pentagon's payroll who pushed departmental agendas without disclosing their official ties.
stichpunkte: The Pentagon employs multiple prominent right-wing social media commentators as special government employees.
The secret was exposed when influencer Jennica Pounds accused a State Department official of entrapment over non-classified document markings.
Pounds panicked on social media, posting text exchanges and claiming the deep state tried to set her up for a crime.
Subsequent reporting revealed that other conservative influencers like Rob Maness and Kurt Schlichter also hold undisclosed civilian positions at the Pentagon.
Guest Will Sommer discussed how these figures function simultaneously as government personnel and partisan influencers.
The Pentagon has refused to disclose the specific duties, supervisors, or compensation for these special government employees.
Critics note that while these influencers built audiences by railing against the deep state, they are now part of an opaque government apparatus.

clips.hook: A secret that almost remained buried
clips.text: Recent revelations show the Pentagon is secretly employing prominent conservative social media commentators.
The first uncovered Pentagon employee accumulated a massive following of close to a million users on Twitter.

clips.hook: Brought down by a lack of basic awareness
clips.text: The scandal broke out purely because a prominent online conspiracy theorist panicked over routine administrative procedures.
The guest compares the data-driven tactics of the exposed influencer to classic number-crunching conspiracy figures.
Right-wing commentators often dismiss potential conflicts of interest by claiming standard professional rules do not apply to them.

beschreibung:
This past week prominent right wing twitter poster, Jennica Pounds (DataRepublican), got paranoid after being handed documents by the State Department, leading to the revelation that the Pentagon is employing conservative influencers as “special government employees.” Travis details Pounds’ history and the events that led up to her legal illiteracy failure. Later we welcome back Will Sommer for his 10th appearance on the pod to discuss his reporting on the matter and what we know about these special government employee influencers and the role they may be playing in the Pentagon.
